items.source: Launcher for JAR based archives. This launcher assumes that dependency jars are included inside a /BOOT-INF/lib directory and that application classes are included inside a /BOOT-INF/classes directory.
items.translation: Launcher 用于基于 JAR 的归档。此启动器假设依赖 jar 包含在 /BOOT-INF/lib 目录中，而应用程序类包含在 /BOOT-INF/classes 目录中。

items.source: Phillip Webb, Andy Wilkinson, Madhura Bhave, Scott Frederick
items.translation: Phillip Webb, Andy Wilkinson, Madhura Bhave, Scott Frederick
